methods.name: D2FLS-Net (Dual-Stage DEM-guided Fusion Transformer for landslide segmentation)
methods.summary: A Swin-Transformer-based semantic segmentation network that incorporates two novel modules: the Dual-Stage DEM-Guided Fusion (DSDF) module for multi-level topographic guidance and the Terrain-aware Pixel-wise Adaptive Context Enhancement (T-PACE) module for adaptive receptive field selection.
